exclusions.attributes:(map, val) : should throw wit: Invalid-input error compatibility is not a performance gate.

exclusions.addClass, removeClass, hasClass on eleme: jQuery uses ASCII class whitespace; Cheerio uses JavaScript whitespace and preserves existing spacing when adding classes.
